svg.title: One token on the CPU
svg.desc: Flowchart: the prefix cache, prefill or decode threads, the per-layer dispatch (GPU stage, own layouts, SSM, DeltaNet, short convolution, attention), dense or mixture-of-experts feed-forward with experts in RAM, on disk, offloaded or remote, the sampler on the CPU or the GPU, speculative decoding, and the CPU kernels.
svg.text: A session's pass: the prompt or one token, every layer by its family, the experts where the plan put them, the sampler and the drafts
